moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Returns
moments.blurb: The 24th series of Strictly Come Dancing kicks off with its highly anticipated launch show this Saturday, revealing the celebrity-pro pairings for 2026.

angles.name: Launch Show Buzz
angles.copy: Glitterball season is officially upon us! ✨ Strictly Come Dancing launches this Saturday, September 19th, on BBC One. Who are you hoping gets paired with who?

angles.name: New Hosts
angles.copy: Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are taking over the Strictly ballroom! Catch the new presenting trio on the launch show this Saturday.

angles.name: Anticipation
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! The Strictly Come Dancing launch show airs this Saturday, September 19th. Get ready for the first dance of the season!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Jason Derulo
moments.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and dancer Jason Derulo, known for hits like 'Whatcha Say' and 'Talk Dirty', turns 37 on September 21st.

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 37th Birthday to the incredible Jason Derulo this Saturday, September 21st! What's your favourite track from him?

angles.name: Career Highlights
angles.copy: From 'Whatcha Say' to 'Savage Love', Jason Derulo has given us so many bangers! He turns 37 this Saturday. Tune in to hear his biggest hits.

moments.title: The Great British Bake Off Returns
moments.blurb: Series 17 of The Great British Bake Off begins next Tuesday, September 22nd, on Channel 4, with Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood as a new judge.

angles.name: Bake Off is Back
angles.copy: On your marks, get set... BAKE! 🎂 The Great British Bake Off returns for Series 17 next Tuesday, September 22nd, at 8pm on Channel 4. Who's excited?

angles.name: New Judge Nigella
angles.copy: A new ingredient in the tent! Nigella Lawson joins Paul Hollywood as a judge for the new series of The Great British Bake Off, starting next Tuesday.

angles.name: Baking Season
angles.copy: Autumn officially begins with the return of The Great British Bake Off! Grab your spatulas and get ready for soggy bottoms from next Tuesday, 8pm, Channel 4.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Andrea Bocelli
moments.blurb: The celebrated Italian tenor Andrea Bocelli, known for his beautiful classical crossover music, turns 68 on September 22nd.

angles.name: Birthday Maestro
angles.copy: Wishing a magnificent 68th Birthday to the legendary Andrea Bocelli this Tuesday, September 22nd. His voice is truly timeless.

angles.name: Voice of an Angel
angles.copy: Celebrate the birthday of Andrea Bocelli on Tuesday! Immerse yourself in the incredible sounds of one of the world's most beloved tenors.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Bruce Springsteen
moments.blurb: American rock icon 'The Boss' Bruce Springsteen, famed for his epic concerts and hits like 'Born to Run', celebrates his 77th birthday on September 23rd.

angles.name: Boss's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the one and only Bruce Springsteen this Wednesday, September 23rd! What's your all-time favourite 'Boss' track?

angles.name: Rock Legend
angles.copy: From the E Street Band to stadiums worldwide, Bruce Springsteen is a true rock legend. Celebrate his 77th birthday this Wednesday with his greatest hits!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Will Smith
moments.blurb: The multi-talented actor and rapper Will Smith, known for 'The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air' and global blockbusters, turns 58 on September 25th.

angles.name: Fresh Prince Turns 58
angles.copy: Can you believe it? Will Smith turns 58 this Friday, September 25th! From West Philadelphia born and raised, to Hollywood superstar – what's your favourite Will Smith moment?

angles.name: Actor & Rapper
angles.copy: He's conquered music, TV, and film! Celebrate Will Smith's 58th birthday this Friday by cranking up his biggest tunes.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Avril Lavigne
moments.blurb: Canadian pop-punk icon Avril Lavigne, known for her anthems like 'Complicated' and 'Sk8er Boi', celebrates her 42nd birthday on September 27th.

angles.name: Pop-Punk Princess
angles.copy: It's Avril Lavigne's 42nd birthday on Sunday, September 27th! Get ready to feel like a 'Sk8er Boi' as we celebrate the pop-punk legend.

angles.name: Still Complicated?
angles.copy: 42 years young! Avril Lavigne celebrates her birthday this Sunday. What's your favourite throwback track from the 'Complicated' singer?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Lil Wayne
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning American rapper Lil Wayne, a highly influential figure in hip-hop, turns 44 on September 27th.

angles.name: Tunechi's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 44th Birthday to the one and only Lil Wayne this Sunday, September 27th! The Young Money boss has given us so many iconic tracks.

angles.name: Hip-Hop Legend
angles.copy: Celebrating the birthday of a true hip-hop legend, Lil Wayne, this Sunday! What's your go-to Weezy track?
